title: tragacantha porrecta
intro: Tragacantha porrecta, commonly known as Salsola tragus, is a type of invasive plant species. It has been traditionally used in various cultures for its medicinal properties. The plant is believed to have health benefits such as reducing inflammation and improving digestion due to its antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents found in Salsola tragus include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its therapeutic actions like antimicrobial and anti-inflammatory effects.
